list: the official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are original, written for this entry, and cite their sources beside each trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn, and it pops on its own the moment the other 54 are done. There is no shortcut and no extra task behind it: finish the story, the side strands, the activities and the 100% checklist, and the platinum follows. It needs no multiplayer and no DLC, so everything happens in the single-player game.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (no multiplayer or DLC needed)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first mission of the story, so you earn this within your first session just by following the opening beats until the mission completes. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops a little late, once you have cleared the first mission or two of the next chapter, so do not worry if it does not appear the instant the chapter ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one missable-adjacent thing in this guide: the morning meditation at Jason's house, covered under Positive Mental Attitude.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (pops a little late; Chapter 1 meditation warning)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it can pop a mission or two into the next chapter, which is normal. From Chapter 2 on, both characters can roam together, which is when partner trophies such as Hot Together become possible.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (late pop; both characters roaming from Chapter 2)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. This is the chapter where several side strands open up — Andy's strand starts with a phone call here, and so do Randy's and Tyrone's — so answer the calls and bank the introductions while you play through. The Snap Gun and the dye pack jammer, both needed for later trophies, also arrive through Chapter 3 main missions.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (side strands opening in Chapter 3; Snap Gun and dye pack jammer in Chapter 3 missions)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Three of the story's specific-mission trophies sit in this chapter, so play it through to the end rather than rushing past its missions. The optional bank-vault mission also opens here, and there are 8 vaults in total — robbing 5 earns Maximum Withdrawal, while the 100% checklist needs all 8.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (three specific-mission trophies in Chapter 4; bank vaults open in Chapter 4, 8 in total)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story, in Chapter 5. It is the only gold trophy in the story set and the last story trophy you will earn. Free roam continues after the story, so everything you have not finished yet stays available.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (final mission in Chapter 5; free roam continues after the story)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Breakfast Run when it comes up in the story. It unlocks automatically as you play through — there is nothing extra to do beyond finishing the mission itself.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist when it comes up in the story. Like every story-mission trophy, it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed — just play the story through.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Child's Play when it comes up in the story. It unlocks automatically on finishing the mission, so there is no separate objective to chase.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Headliners when it comes up in the story. It is one of the six specific-mission story trophies, and it pops when the mission ends.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (six specific-mission story trophies: one in Chapter 2, one in Chapter 3, three in Chapter 4, one in Chapter 5)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission VCIA Takedown when it comes up in the story. It is one of the six specific-mission story trophies. Note the airport itself matters for another trophy: Catch Me If You Can asks you to steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about a kilometre away.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (jet theft at VCIA for Catch Me If You Can)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory when it comes up in the story. It is the last of the six specific-mission story trophies, and it pops when the mission ends.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (six specific-mission story trophies)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which opens after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It is the hardest trophy in the set and the last thing most players earn: PowerPyx puts the whole platinum at about 200 hours, Push Square at 250 hours or more. The checklist is lenient — PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion — but it still needs 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all shooting ranges and drone races, and 15 of 18 card sets. Progress you made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (checklist location; 70 of 80 challenges; 15 of 18 meditations; 300 stunts; all vaults, operations, ranges and races; about 200 hours)
Push Square, via sixshore.com (250+ hours; 15 of 18 card sets)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts of any kind across Leonida: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and PowerPyx counts 397 stunt spots in total. The trophy needs 250, while the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this pop. Stunts also count toward the activity types for Master of None, so fold them into your free-roam driving and flying.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (397 stunt spots; 100% needs 300)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt, as PowerPyx lists them. You only need to try each one, not finish or win it, so sample them early and this pops fast. Several of them lead into their own trophies — fishing into Baited My Tackle, the shooting range into The Shootist, races into Earn Cash, Not Kudos.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (the 9 types by name)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The ranges are one of the 9 activity types, so a visit here also feeds Master of None. The 100% checklist needs every shooting range too, so golding them all now saves a return trip later. Take your time on the later challenges — accuracy beats speed on the gold thresholds.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (100% needs every shooting range)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. You only need one win per location, not every race at each one. Drone races are also one of the things the 100% checklist needs in full, so winning them all now counts twice.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (100% needs all drone races)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race counts once, so you need 20 distinct events rather than 20 wins in the same one. Races are also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so your first race there does double duty.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You meet Cal in Chapter 1, and after that he texts you a fishing spot — head there when the message arrives and win the challenge. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types, so this pairs naturally with Master of None.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (Cal texts a fishing spot after you meet him in Chapter 1)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any one in-game video game through to the end. Three of them run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines out in the world — pick whichever you find first and finish it. Playing a video game is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (three games on the TV at home, a fourth on arcade machines)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand, playing as Lucia. It starts with a phone call in Chapter 3, so answer it when it comes and follow the strand to its final mission. Side strands stay available after the story, so there is no rush — but do not leave it to the very end either, since it is one of the eight strands Strangers & Freaks needs.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (Lucia only; starts with a phone call in Chapter 3)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure diving strand, which covers 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later in the story, so do not worry if his strand seems to stall — it is not missable, and he comes back. Finish all 7 wrecks and his final mission to earn this.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (7 shipwrecks; Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, not missable)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2 — head to the mud club when it appears and follow the strand to its final mission. Like the other side strands, it stays available after the story.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (mud club in Kelly County; opens in Chapter 2)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some side questlines count, and PowerPyx was still confirming exactly which ones at launch — the five character finals in this guide (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus Bret's hunt and the other stranger strands are the pool to draw from. This trophy is not part of the 100% checklist, so it can still be waiting after everything else is done; save it for the cleanup stage and work through whatever strands remain.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (only some questlines count; not part of 100%)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand, which is a wish list of 16 sports cars to find and deliver. It opens in Chapter 3. Scan cars with the WAiNK app as you play — scanning counts toward discovering vehicles for Whip It Good too, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base vehicles, so every scan helps twice.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (wish list of 16 sports cars; opens in Chapter 3)
PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (100% needs 200 of 277 vehicles)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by shutting down labs in Vice City, playing as Jason. It opens in Chapter 3 — follow the strand's missions until the labs are closed and the final mission is done.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (Jason only, from Chapter 3; shutting down labs in Vice City)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy the guides flag as possibly missable, so handle it early: during Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony — follow her and accept the optional quest, because that meditation is gone after Chapter 1. PowerPyx reports that it raises the meditation counter by one but is not marked as a meditation spot like the other 18, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx had done it when the trophy unlocked, so do it when it comes up. It takes a minute and removes the risk. The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 spots, so the rest can wait until cleanup.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (Chapter 1 house meditation; possibly missable; 100% needs 15 of 18)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, playing as Jason, from Chapter 2. PowerPyx had not confirmed which animal triggers it at launch, so do not chase a single species on a guess: clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which the 100% checklist needs anyway, should cover it. Study animals through the binoculars as you go — the checklist needs 100 of 255 studied, and you do not have to hunt them.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (Jason only, from Chapter 2; animal unconfirmed; all 15 target decks should cover it; 100% needs 100 of 255 animals studied)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 in the game. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so pick up every set you pass while doing other things and finish the three smallest sets first. The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so this trophy comes on the way to the full cleanup — a few magazine collectibles sit in story buildings that close off, but they also spawn elsewhere, so nothing is locked away for good.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (3 of 18 sets; 100% needs 15 of 18; closed-off collectibles also spawn elsewhere)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count, so scan anything interesting whenever you pass it — the habit pays off twice, because scanning vehicles with WAiNK is also how Whip It Good's 100 discovered vehicles are counted, and you do not even have to drive them. Make it a reflex: new place, new vehicle, scan it.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (landmarks, curiosities and sculptures count; scanning vehicles is enough for Whip It Good)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Challenges cover the same ground as the rest of the list — stunts, races, robberies, collectibles — so most of them complete themselves while you chase other trophies. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way and you will keep going past it.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. This becomes possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2 — bank jobs give you 4 stars anyway, so the easiest route is to start a bank job with your partner along, then break line of sight and lay low until the heat dies down. Do not split up mid-chase: the trophy needs your partner beside you when the stars clear.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (possible once both characters roam together in Chapter 2; bank jobs give 4 stars)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them. Keep the heat on all the way through: hit one shop, move straight to the next, and do not let the stars clear. PowerPyx notes the trophy pops about 30 seconds after the third shop, so give it half a minute before deciding it failed.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (pops about 30 seconds after the third shop)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not have to drive them — so scan every new vehicle you see, starting from the first hours of the game. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base model vehicles, so the scanning habit you build here carries straight into the cleanup.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (scanning with WAiNK is enough; 100% needs 200 of 277)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Pick a busy fight and trigger it once several enemies are in view — PowerPyx reports that gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to, so aim this at a gang fight rather than a police chase. Five quick, close targets in one slow-motion window is the whole trick.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (gang members count; soldiers, police and civilians seem not to)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about a kilometre away. Walk the terminal, board a jet at its gate, and take off — once you are roughly a kilometre from the airport the trophy pops. Come in quiet if you can: a full runway alert makes the getaway messier than it needs to be.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at VCIA; fly about 1 km away)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx found them at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest of the map — head there, grab a Rhino and drive it clear. Expect a heavy response once you are in it, so plan your exit route before you climb in rather than after.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (tanks at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you, so this only opens from Chapter 3 on. Case the store first, move when the staff are not looking, and get out before anyone raises the alarm — one spotted moment voids the attempt, but you can retry the robbery.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (Snap Gun from a Chapter 3 main mission)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4, and there are 8 vaults in total — this trophy needs 5, while the 100% checklist needs all 8, so plan to hit every one eventually. Bank jobs also hand you the 4-star wanted level Hot Together needs, so bring your partner along for one of them and let the two trophies overlap.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; 8 vaults; 100% needs all 8)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or you can do it earlier on your own: blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb and take the cash before the response arrives. Either way, the escape is the part that counts — clear the wanted level after the grab.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (first bank job counts; or blow open the back door with a sticky bomb)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida until the map fog is gone — the tracker counts 52 areas. The fastest way is a plane: fly a grid over the state and watch the fog lift area by area, then mop up the corners on foot or by car. Exploring also feeds the other discovery trophies, since new areas hold new vehicles to scan and new spots to WAiNK.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (clear the fog from the entire map; a plane is fastest)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this trophy is the first third of a much longer job — hit one per gang for the pop, then keep going through the rest during cleanup. Operations also pay well, which helps the money trophies.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (100% needs all 39 operations)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact method is not yet confirmed in the game — no guide had pinned it down at launch — so treat any specific bar or interaction you read about as unconfirmed until players verify it. What the trophy itself asks is plain: a cocktail, with a view, on Ocean Beach. Try the beachfront bars and cafés first.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (exact method not yet confirmed)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is not yet confirmed in the game — no guide had pinned it down at launch — so do not trust a specific showroom or vehicle named in an early post until players verify it. The shape of it is clear from the description: get a vehicle inside a showroom, then drive it straight out through the glass.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (exact method not yet confirmed)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. It is a gang operation, not a game of bowling — clear it and grab all three valuables. The robbery comes back later if you miss anything, so it is not missable; and since gang operations feed Pest Control and the 100% checklist, this one counts three ways at once.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn; the robbery comes back later, not missable)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out strength on both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both make progress at the same time, so pair their gym sessions instead of grinding one character and then the other. One note on the listing itself: Push Square does not mark this trophy as hidden, while most trackers do — either way, the requirement is the same.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (max out strength on both Jason and Lucia; work out together)
Push Square, via sixshore.com (does not mark this one as hidden)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your criminal profile. It comes naturally: almost everything you do in the game — missions, robberies, stunts, activities — nudges the profile, so this pops on its own somewhere in the middle of a full playthrough. Turn on progress and criminal profile notifications in the UI settings so you can see what counts.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (it comes naturally; turn on progress and criminal profile notifications)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed in the game. PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store, but that is a suspicion, not a verified method — do not treat it as a fact. The description hints at succeeding on a second try, so if you fail something and retry it, watch for this pop; until players verify the trigger, this guide will not invent one.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (not yet confirmed; suspects a link to a Payday Loans store)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed in the game. PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline, but that is a suspicion, not a verified method — the description's 'what the hell just happened?' fits a strange encounter, and a UFO thread would match, but until players verify the trigger this guide will not invent a location or a step. Keep an eye on odd events in free roam and check back once the community confirms it.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (not yet confirmed; suspects a UFO questline)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle — but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed, so treat the motorcycle kick as a lead to try, not a fact. Ride past a target at speed and swing: if it does not pop, try another vehicle and another angle.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (not yet confirmed; in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle; suspects a kick from a motorcycle)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your fences. It adds up across robberies, so you do not need a single huge haul — keep laundering after every job. The dye pack jammer, which you need for laundering, unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission, so this only starts counting properly from Chapter 3 on. Bank vaults are the best late-game earner if you need to top it up.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (adds up across robberies; dye pack jammer unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission; bank vaults the best late-game earner)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest — and you will want most of that gear anyway, so buy as you go instead of saving it all for the end. It counts across every shop in the game, so the total creeps up on its own during a normal playthrough.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. PowerPyx puts the total at $160,000. The real estate app arrives in Chapter 2, so garage shopping only opens from there — buy them as you can afford them, and remember you need garage space first before the Scooter Bros app will let you register vehicles for On the Spot, so pair the two trophies.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (total $160,000; real estate app arrives in Chapter 2)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so buy garages for Little Boxes and then register the vehicles you store in them. Scan each new vehicle with WAiNK as you find it — the scanning habit also feeds Whip It Good — and register your favourites as you go.
sources: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com (you need garage space first; pair it with Little Boxes)

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.body: Play Chapters 1 to 5 at your own pace. All 12 story trophies pop as you go, and the final mission's gold closes the stage. Two things matter while you play: do the Chapter 1 morning meditation at Jason's house for Positive Mental Attitude, and take optional missions as they appear — the 100% checklist needs any 100 of them. Scan every new vehicle with WAiNK and study new animals through the binoculars; both feed the cleanup. Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter: missions cannot be replayed, and there are 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave. Cheats disable trophies and stop the game saving, so keep them off this file.

roadmap.title: Side strands
roadmap.body: Finish the stranger strands: Andy (Lucia, from a Chapter 3 phone call), Kenton (7 shipwrecks; he goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns), Billy (mud club, Kelly County, from Chapter 2), Randy (16 sports cars, from Chapter 3), Tyrone (labs in Vice City, Jason, from Chapter 3), and Bret's hunt (Jason, from Chapter 2). Eight strands in total earn Strangers & Freaks, which is not part of the 100% checklist — so it can still be waiting after everything else is done.

roadmap.title: Activities and challenges
roadmap.body: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win drone races at all 14 Top Fun locations, win 20 different races, pull 250 stunts, beat Cal at fishing, finish one arcade game, try all 9 activity types, and work through 50 of the 80 challenges. Hunt the open-world stunts in this stage too: the jet at VCIA, the tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the bowling operation in Port Gellhorn, and maxing strength on both characters. Five of these trophies are still unconfirmed at launch — check their guides before chasing a guess.

roadmap.title: Robberies and money
roadmap.body: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults (the checklist needs all 8), an armored truck, a jewelry store undetected with the Snap Gun, 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, and one illegal operation per gang. Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your fences and spend $100,000 across the shops. Bank vaults are the best late-game earner, and a bank job with your partner along also hands you the 4-star wanted level for Hot Together.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap.body: Complete 3 of the 18 card sets, scan 100 WAiNK spots, discover 100 vehicles, clear the fog from all 52 areas of Leonida, buy all 8 garages for $160,000, and register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. A plane is the fastest way to clear the map fog. The 100% checklist is stricter than the trophies here — 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles — so keep collecting past each pop.

roadmap.title: The long cleanup and the platinum
roadmap.body: After the story, the 100% checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Work it top to bottom: 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all shooting ranges and drone races, all of Bret's target decks, 100 of 255 animals studied, 100 optional missions. PowerPyx calls the checklist lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and nothing on it is missable. When it hits 100%, A Long Road pops, and the platinum follows with it.

facts.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and stop the game saving (PowerPyx, Push Square)
